definitions.supplemental: Dere the Deirians, wudu a wood: the wood of the Deirians

quotations.old_english: Se sóþfæsta Berhthun eft wæs abbud ðæs mynstres ðæt ys gecýged on Dyra wuda
quotations.latin: veriacissimus Bercthun nunc abbas monasterii quod vocātur in Derauuda, id est, in silva Derōrum

quotations.old_english: He wæs bebyriged in Sce' Petres portice on his mynstre ðæt is cweden in Dera wuda
quotations.latin: sepultus est in porticu sancti Petri, in monasterio suo, quod dicitur in silva Derōrum

quotations.old_english: Iohannes fór to his mynstre on Dera wuda
quotations.english: John went to his monastery at Beverley

source_text: Dyra wudu, Dera wudu; gen. dat. wuda; m. [Dere the Deirians, wudu a wood: the wood of the Deirians] Beverley, Yorkshire; opp&i-short;di nomen in agro Eboracensi :-- Se sóþfæsta Berhthun eft wæs abbud ðæs mynstres ðæt ys gecýged on Dyra wuda veraciss&i-short;mus Bercthun nunc abbas monast&e-long;rii quod voc&a-long;tur in Derauuda, id est, in silva Der&o-long;rum, Bd. 5, 2; S. 614, 29. He wæs bebyriged in Sce' Petres portice on his mynstre ðæt is cweden in Dera wuda sepultus est in port&i-short;cu sancti Petri, in monast&e-long;rio suo, quod dic&i-short;tur in silva Der&o-long;rum, 5, 6; S. 620, 21. Iohannes fór to his mynstre on Dera wuda John went to his monastery at Beverley, Chr. 685; Erl. 41, 35.
